sections.text: Introduction

This document lists the equipment inspection I1, which must be 
performed on monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title block

The first draft is initiated by eng. Mostafa Ali 
Kheder tested by eng.Sherif Mahrous . quality control general director eng 
Gamal Abd Elwahab, accepted by technical expert eng. Hassan Elbehiry and 
approved by eng. Mohamed Gamal Diab Head sector of El-Kureimat power 
station.

Safety
Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Don't smoke in the battery room.

Use standard personal safety equipment (goggles, protective 
 clothing, rubber gloves)
Don't use any tools on top of battery.
All tools will be used must be insulated.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

Standard personal safety equipment, safety goggles, rubber gloves, and 
 rubber apron.

items:
Standard personal safety equipment, safety goggles, rubber gloves, and 
 rubber apron.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Read total voltage of bank and record 
 it on battery maintenance card.

Disconnect AC supply to battery 
 charger.

Check the electrolyte 
 levels and adjust if necessary

Inspect the container of cells for 
 cracks and leakage of electrolyte.

If you discover a defective cell use 
 the recommended procedure to replace with new cell.

Record density for each cell, add distilled water if level is below 
 normal.

Inspect inter-cell connectors and 
 terminals of cells and clean any salt deposits with distilled water.

Check terminal connections for 
 tightness.

Clean terminal connection with soft 
 brush.

Check and add a thin film of Vaseline 
 to the terminal connections
Check for vent cap damage.

Read voltage per cell and record it on 
 battery maintenance card.

Return battery bank to regular 
 service.
